summary: An autonomous, multi-agent trading platform that unifies scanning, scoring, governance, and execution into one supervised AI intelligence layer — built for intelligent, rules-driven finance.

bnai.name: BNAI
bnai.description: Proprietary trade scoring framework. Technical bars, real-time news catalysts, and multi-agent AI synthesis must align before execution is authorized.
rules: Good chart + strong news + AI confirms → trade authorized
Good chart + bad news → no trade
Hot news + weak chart → no trade

tiers.name: CIO Command Layer
agents: Aggregates all agent reports — final decision with full context and reasoning

automation_cycle: After market close — classify market regime
Overnight — scan premarket movers, rank candidates, compliance checks
Pre-market — build daily battle plan, update memory models
Market open — score live trades, monitor positions, apply stops
Intraday — re-check regime, react to news, manage positions
End of day — EOD agent closes positions, logs decisions, resets governance

compliance.title: Fully Logged
compliance.text: Every trade, decision, and agent action recorded with context and timestamp

compliance.title: Human Override
compliance.text: Operators can intervene, pause, or override at any moment

compliance.title: Regulated Broker
compliance.text: Execution routed through Alpaca — registered broker-dealer integration

compliance.title: Audit Trail
compliance.text: Decision context stored for review and forensics

compliance.title: Supervised AI
compliance.text: AI intelligence layer — not an unaccountable black-box algorithm
